metadata.title: Nasdaq Futures Rise After AI Stocks Rally in Asia and Europe - WSJ

content.text:
Nasdaq futures rose after artificial-intelligence stocks rallied in Asia and Europe, though investor sentiment remained muted as oil prices held close to $110 a barrel.
After volatile trade in the last session ended with the Nasdaq closing flat, futures for the tech-heavy index gained 0.6% on Wednesday. Investor concerns remain around the business models of cloud-computing companies and the impact of higher borrowing rates on the AI ecosystem. Still, chip makers and data-center stocks rose across the board premarket. Micron Technology MU 1.53%increase; up pointing triangle and Intel each gained over 2% premarket as investors moved back into AI names that fell sharply last week.
